store.summary: System monitor: CPU, processes, network speed, battery, level and sound meter
store.description: SysMon shows what your CardputerZero is doing, across six pages. Overview: CPU with a 60-second graph, per-core load, RAM, temperature and battery. Processes: the top 5 by CPU or memory, and you can end one from the keyboard. Network: interfaces, Wi-Fi signal and a live download/upload speed graph. Power: 4-minute temperature history, battery time-left / time-to-full estimate, disk and uptime. Level: a bubble level from the built-in motion sensor. Sound: a live microphone loudness meter. Left/Right or Tab switch pages, 1-6 jump, ESC quits.
